mapper.sql: SELECT STATEMENT_ID, ENTERPRISE_ID, ENTERPRISE_NAME, STATEMENT_TYPE, PERIOD_TYPE, REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, START_DATE, END_DATE, STATEMENT_STATUS, AUDIT_STATUS, AUDIT_FIRM, AUDIT_OPINION, AUDIT_DATE, PREPARING_UNIT, PREPARED_BY, PREPARED_DATE, REVIEWED_BY, REVIEWED_DATE, APPROVED_BY, APPROVED_DATE, SUBMISSION_STATUS, SUBMISSION_DATE, SUBMISSION_ORGANIZATION, DATA_SOURCE, DATA_QUALITY_LEVEL, DATA_COMPLETENESS_SCORE, DATA_ACCURACY_SCORE, DATA_TIMELINESS_SCORE, DATA_CONSISTENCY_SCORE, IS_CONSOLIDATED, CONSOLIDATION_SCOPE, ACCOUNTING_STANDARDS, CURRENCY, EXCHANGE_RATE, ACCOUNTING_POLICY_CHANGES, ACCOUNTING_ESTIMATE_CHANGES, PRIOR_PERIOD_ADJUSTMENTS, NEED_REGULATORY_ATTENTION, REGULATORY_ATTENTION_REASON, RISK_LEVEL, RISK_FACTORS, HAS_ANOMALIES, ANOMALY_DESCRIPTION, QUALITY_CHECK_RESULT, QUALITY_CHECKED_BY, QUALITY_CHECK_DATE, COMPLIANCE_CHECK_RESULT, COMPLIANCE_CHECKED_BY, COMPLIANCE_CHECK_DATE, ATTACHMENT_FILES, REMARKS, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER, VERSION, DELETED FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT
mapper.select: WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR DESC, REPORT_PERIOD DESC
WHERE STATEMENT_TYPE = #{statementType} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR DESC, REPORT_PERIOD DESC
WHERE NEED_REGULATORY_ATTENTION = #{needRegulatoryAttention} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
WHERE HAS_ANOMALIES = #{hasAnomalies} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY ANOMALY_DETECTION_DATE DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, AVG(DATA_COMPLETENESS_SCORE) as avgCompletenessScore, AVG(DATA_ACCURACY_SCORE) as avgAccuracyScore, AVG(DATA_TIMELINESS_SCORE) as avgTimelinessScore, AVG(DATA_CONSISTENCY_SCORE) as avgConsistencyScore, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATA_QUALITY_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highQualityCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATA_QUALITY_LEVEL = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 END) as mediumQualityCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATA_QUALITY_LEVEL = 'LOW' THEN 1 END) as lowQualityCount FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0

SELECT STATEMENT_ID, ENTERPRISE_NAME, REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, ANOMALY_DESCRIPTION, ANOMALY_DETECTION_DATE, RISK_LEVEL, RISK_FACTORS FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND HAS_ANOMALIES = 1 AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY ANOMALY_DETECTION_DATE DESC

SELECT RISK_LEVEL, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(RISK_SCORE) as avgRiskScore, MAX(RISK_SCORE) as maxRiskScore, MIN(RISK_SCORE) as minRiskScore FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY RISK_LEVEL ORDER BY avgRiskScore DESC

SELECT COMPLIANCE_STATUS, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN COMPLIANCE_ISSUES IS NOT NULL AND COMPLIANCE_ISSUES != '' THEN 1 END) as issueCount FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY COMPLIANCE_STATUS

SELECT STATEMENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN AUDIT_STATUS = 'AUDITED' THEN 1 END) as auditedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN HAS_ANOMALIES = 1 THEN 1 END) as anomalyCount FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT WHERE REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY STATEMENT_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT AUDIT_STATUS, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT WHERE REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0), 2) as percentage FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT WHERE REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY AUDIT_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN AUDIT_STATUS = 'AUDITED' THEN 1 END) as auditedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN HAS_ANOMALIES = 1 THEN 1 END) as anomalyCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_REGULATORY_ATTENTION = 1 THEN 1 END) as regulatoryAttentionCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN COMPLIANCE_STATUS = 'COMPLIANT' THEN 1 END) as compliantCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATA_QUALITY_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highQualityCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highRiskCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATEMENT_STATUS = 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 END) as submittedCount, AVG(DATA_COMPLETENESS_SCORE) as avgCompletenessScore, AVG(RISK_SCORE) as avgRiskScore, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as statisticsTime FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT WHERE DELETED = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN AUDIT_STATUS = 'AUDITED' THEN 1 END) as auditedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN HAS_ANOMALIES = 1 THEN 1 END) as anomalyCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_REGULATORY_ATTENTION = 1 THEN 1 END) as regulatoryAttentionCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN COMPLIANCE_STATUS = 'COMPLIANT' THEN 1 END) as compliantCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATA_QUALITY_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highQualityCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highRiskCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATEMENT_STATUS = 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 END) as submittedCount, AVG(DATA_COMPLETENESS_SCORE) as avgCompletenessScore, AVG(RISK_SCORE) as avgRiskScore, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as statisticsTime FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT WHERE DELETED = 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT SET STATEMENT_STATUS = #{statementStatus}, UPDATE_TIME =
NOW() SYSDATE
WHERE STATEMENT_ID IN
#{id}
AND DELETED = 0

UPDATE GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT SET HAS_ANOMALIES = 1, ANOMALY_DESCRIPTION = #{anomalyDescription}, ANOMALY_DETECTION_DATE =
NOW() SYSDATE , UPDATE_TIME =
NOW() SYSDATE
WHERE STATEMENT_ID = #{statementId} AND DELETED = 0

UPDATE GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT SET RISK_LEVEL = #{riskLevel}, RISK_FACTORS = #{riskFactors}, UPDATE_TIME =
NOW() SYSDATE
WHERE STATEMENT_ID = #{statementId} AND DELETED = 0
